answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 4 times its size, so a group of 16 keys loses far more than 16 single identities would. The dune graph is rebuilt each epoch, and therefore the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the ember audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the lantern checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
